title: 常见话题词汇
goal: 理解五类面试话题中的常用词语，并根据回答内容选择准确表达。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 认识常见话题的词和短语
在回答中选用合适的词

body.p: 话题词要放在句子里理解。deadline 是最后期限，schedule 是时间安排。I changed my schedule to meet the deadline. 一句里两个词都用到了，意思不同，不能互换。
选词时还要看词性和搭配。concentrate on a task 用介词 on。make a reservation 表示预订：订好了还没有到达，也不是整个旅行计划。

cards.title: 词汇表：学习习惯
rows: Reviewing a page before breakfast is part of my routine.
I concentrate on one problem at a time.
I review the examples after each class.
I take notes on the steps I find difficult.
I finish the draft before the deadline.
I set aside an evening for exam revision.
My schedule includes a break after each workshop.
Messages are a distraction when I read.
按重要性排列；优先处理
I prioritize tasks that are due soon.
A short self-assessment shows which skills I need to practice.
cards.note: revision 可指考前复习，也可指修改文稿：exam revision 是复习，revision of a draft 是修订。

cards.title: 词汇表：校园生活
rows: My residence hall has a shared kitchen.
My roommate and I agreed on quiet hours.
Each student discusses a reading in the seminar.
I ask about the assignment during office hours.
The sports facility has an indoor track.
The cafeteria serves lunch near the lecture rooms.
I completed enrollment before classes began.
The tuition fee does not include housing.
The rehearsal schedule is on the noticeboard.
cards.note: office hours 是教师安排的答疑时间，不是办公楼的开放时间。

cards.title: 词汇表：兼职与职业
rows: The internship let me observe how a newsroom works.
My part-time job fits around my classes.
My evening shift ends before the last bus.
A colleague showed me how to use the till.
My supervisor checks the weekly rota.
Checking stock is one of my responsibilities.
The role requires a qualification in first aid.
The placement gave me useful work experience.
Learning another language may improve my career prospects.
My former supervisor agreed to provide a reference.
cards.note: reference 也可指引用的文献。求职时 provide a reference 指提供推荐证明。

cards.title: 词汇表：科技与日常
rows: I use one device for reading and taking notes.
This application stores my handwritten notes.
I turn off notifications during meetings.
I limit my screen time before bed.
I check the privacy settings before sharing a photo.
I use a different password for each account.
I keep a backup of the project on another drive.
I need a reliable connection for online classes.
Paying through the application is convenient.
I canceled the subscription when I stopped using the service.
cards.note: backup 是名词，back up 是动词短语：I keep a backup. / I back up my files.

cards.title: 词汇表：休闲与旅行
rows: Making paper models is my favorite hobby.
I spend some of my leisure time outdoors.
We set aside one afternoon for sightseeing.
Our itinerary includes a morning at the harbor.
We booked accommodation near the station.
I made a reservation for the evening train.
We chose a coastal town as our destination.
Trying the local cuisine was part of the trip.
We used public transport instead of renting a car.
Our travel budget covered transport and meals.
cards.note: itinerary 是活动的先后安排，budget 是花钱的上限。The itinerary changed, but the budget stayed the same.

body.box: I work at a campus cafe after class. A colleague showed me the payment system, and my supervisor sets my shifts. Next term, I hope to use that experience when applying for an internship.

Which phrase refers to the speaker's scheduled period of work?
1. A colleague
2. An internship
3. A shift
4. A payment system

body.p: 答案是第三项。sets my shifts 说明主管安排的是工作的班次。internship 是下学期打算申请的实习，不是现在的工作时段。
一段回答可以用到几个话题的词。after class 说明兼职在下课后。已有的工作经历可以概括为 work experience。internship 还没申请，不能说成已有的经历。

groups.text: I read at the same desk every morning, but messages on my phone keep interrupting me. That repeated study pattern is my routine.

items.stem: What does 'routine' refer to here?
options: The notifications that interrupt reading
The regular pattern of studying each morning
The desk where the reading takes place
A single morning when reading was interrupted
items.why: read … every morning 和 repeated study pattern 说明 routine 是固定的学习安排。

groups.text: Students can ask the lecturer questions during office hours. The main lecture and the weekly seminar take place at other times.

items.stem: What are 'office hours' in this context?
options: The hours when every building is open
The scheduled time of the main lecture
The lecturer's scheduled time for student questions
The time spent by students in every seminar
items.why: ask the lecturer questions during office hours 说明这是教师答疑的时间。讲座和研讨课在别的时间。

groups.text: The employer wants a qualification in food safety. Applicants may have cafe experience, but they must also show the required certificate.

items.stem: What does 'qualification' mean here?
options: Proof of completing the required training
Earlier experience of working in a cafe
The employer's own rules for food safety
A list of applicants with cafe experience
items.why: must also show the required certificate 说明 qualification 是受过规定培训的证明。cafe experience 不能代替它，第二项不对。

groups.text: The design file was lost from the laptop, but I recovered it from a backup on another drive.

items.stem: What was the backup?
options: The laptop the design file was lost from
The process of recovering the lost file
The second drive used for storing files
A separate saved copy of the design file
items.why: recovered it from a backup on another drive 说明 backup 是存在另一个硬盘上的副本，不是硬盘本身。

groups.text: The trip's itinerary lists a gallery visit in the morning and a harbor walk after lunch. Its budget lists the expected expenses.

items.stem: Which information belongs to the itinerary?
options: The maximum amount available for meals
The planned order of visits and activities
The cost of accommodation and admission
The total amount left after buying tickets
items.why: gallery … morning 和 harbor … after lunch 是活动的先后安排。expenses 属于 budget。

groups.text: The student society organizes a discussion each week. Its members are students who joined voluntarily; it is not one of their required seminars.

items.stem: What does 'student society' mean here?
options: A compulsory class on a weekly timetable
The weekly discussion that members attend
A student organization built around an activity
The students who lead each discussion
items.why: members … joined voluntarily 和 organizes a discussion 说明这是学生自愿加入的社团。每周的讨论是社团组织的活动，第二项不对。

groups.text: I have several assignments but limited time. The report due tomorrow is more urgent than the reading due next week.

items.stem: Which sentence describes the needed action?
options: I need to prioritize the report because it is due sooner.
I need to extend the reading because it is due later.
I need to review the deadline instead of doing the report.
I need to remove every assignment from my schedule.
items.why: due tomorrow 比 next week 紧迫。prioritize 表示先做报告。

groups.text: At the dormitory, I share a bedroom with one student. Another student is my class partner but lives in a different building.

items.stem: Which phrase identifies the person sharing the bedroom?
options: My class partner from another building
The residence hall where I live
Every student in the dormitory
My roommate in the dormitory
items.why: share a bedroom with one student 对应 roommate。第一项是住在另一栋楼的同班伙伴。

groups.text: I want a short period of practical training in a publishing company before choosing a career. I am not yet applying for a permanent role.

items.stem: Which sentence best expresses that plan?
options: I am applying for a permanent role in publishing.
I am looking for an internship in publishing.
I have already chosen a career in publishing.
I am training other staff at a publishing company.
items.why: short period of practical training 对应 internship。第一项与 not yet applying for a permanent role 相反。

groups.text: A photo application asks to share my location. I want to control who can access that personal information.

items.stem: Which sentence matches this concern?
options: I am checking which photos the application shared.
I am checking my current location on a map.
I am checking the application's privacy settings.
I am checking whether the application takes photos.
items.why: control who can access … personal information 说的是隐私，对应 privacy settings。

groups.text: Before traveling, I arranged for a guesthouse to hold a room for me. I have not arrived there yet.

items.stem: Which sentence describes the completed arrangement?
options: I made a reservation at the guesthouse.
I arrived and collected my room key.
I booked the room after arriving there.
I reached my destination and checked out.
items.why: hold a room for me 表示已经预订。have not arrived 说明还没到，到达之后的事都不对。

groups.text: On a city visit, I used buses and trams rather than hiring a car. The daily tickets covered both forms of travel.

items.stem: Which expression describes that travel choice?
options: A hired car for getting around the city
Buses only, without trams
Trams rather than buses
Public transport within the city
items.why: buses and trams 属于 public transport。rather than hiring a car 排除了租车。

lines.text: I stop checking messages when I prepare presentations. Notifications are a distraction, so I silence them until the slides are ready.

items.stem: What does 'distraction' refer to in this account?
options: The presentation slides being prepared
Something that pulls attention away from the work
The habit of silencing notifications during work
The moment when the slides are finally ready
items.why: stop checking messages 和 silence them 说明通知会干扰准备，distraction 指分散注意力的事物。

lines.text: My colleague taught me the booking system, but my supervisor assigns my weekly shifts and checks my work.

items.stem: Who is the supervisor in this account?
options: The person who only taught the booking system
The customer who makes a weekly booking
The person who allocates and oversees the speaker's work
The colleague who chooses all customers' appointments
items.why: assigns my weekly shifts and checks my work 说明 supervisor 是安排并检查工作的人。教系统的是 colleague。

lines.text: The language application charges me each month. I want to end that regular payment because I no longer use the service.

items.stem: Which sentence accurately expresses the intended action?
options: I want to cancel my subscription.
I want to keep paying each month.
I want to use the service more often.
I want a cheaper monthly plan.
items.why: charges me each month 和 end that regular payment 说明要停掉按月付费，即取消订阅。

lines.text: For the island visit, I've planned the ferry trip first, a coastal walk next, and a craft market visit in the evening. I want to send my friends that sequence of activities.

items.stem: Which sentence names the information being sent?
options: I'll send the ferry ticket.
I'll send a map of the coastal walk.
I'll send the craft market's opening hours.
I'll send the trip itinerary.
items.why: first、next、in the evening 列出活动的先后顺序，这就是 itinerary。

groups.text: The college charged a tuition fee for instruction. Housing and meals appeared as separate expenses, and the fee did not cover them.

items.stem: Which expense is the tuition fee?
options: The amount charged for teaching
The amount charged for a room
The amount spent on cafeteria meals
The combined amount for all living costs
items.why: for instruction 说明 tuition fee 是教学的费用。separate expenses 说明住宿和餐费另算。

groups.text: During the coastal trip, the group tried regional dishes made by local cooks. The guide called this an introduction to local cuisine.

items.stem: What does 'local cuisine' refer to?
options: The local cooks who prepared the dishes for the group
The area's characteristic food and cooking
The guide's introduction to the coast
The coastal trip taken by the group
items.why: regional dishes made by local cooks 说的是当地的饮食，即 local cuisine。第一项是做菜的人，不是饮食。

groups.text: A student compares what she can do with the goals she set herself. No teacher grades the comparison; she uses it to choose what to practice.

items.stem: Which sentence accurately names this process?
options: Her teacher graded her work.
She compared herself with a classmate.
She carried out a self-assessment.
Her teacher set her goals.
items.why: compares what she can do with … goals 和 No teacher grades 说明是她自己评估自己，即 self-assessment。

groups.text: A student needs somewhere to stay during a weekend workshop. The train ticket and the workshop fee are already paid, but no room is arranged.

items.stem: Which sentence identifies the remaining need?
options: I still need to buy a train ticket.
I still need to pay the workshop fee.
I still need to sign up for the workshop.
I still need to book accommodation.
items.why: somewhere to stay 和 no room is arranged 说明还缺住处，对应 accommodation。车票和报名费都已付。
